decks.notes: This deck focuses on quickly filling up the graveyard with cards like The Underworld Cookbook and Bone Shards to bring out powerful creatures like Emrakul, the Aeons Torn using Goryo's Vengeance. It also includes disruption spells like Inquisition of Kozilek and Thoughtseize to control the opponent's hand while utilizing Atraxa, Grand Unifier to make sure your spells resolve. The deck aims to be aggressive by utilizing the graveyard as a resource and overwhelming the opponent with powerful threats early in the game.

The main focus of this deck is to utilize Indomitable Creativity and Transmogrify to cheat out high-value creatures like Archon of Cruelty. The deck aims to quickly assemble the necessary pieces to create a powerful board state and overwhelm the opponent with strong creatures and disruptive spells. The inclusion of cards like Wrenn and Six and Prismari Command provide additional utility and flexibility to adapt to different matchups. The deck's reliance on combo pieces and synergy makes it a unique and creative choice in Modern gameplay.

The deck focuses on assembling the Amulet Titan combo quickly to ramp into powerful threats like Primeval Titan. Cards like Amulet of Vigor and Dryad of the Ilysian Grove allow for explosive plays and the ability to tutor for key lands like Valakut, the Molten Pinnacle. The deck aims to generate a lot of mana and take advantage of powerful land synergies to overwhelm the opponent with massive threats. This combo deck can quickly set up a dominant board state and win the game in just a few turns.

The main idea of this deck is to control the game by assembling the UrzaTron lands (Urza's Tower, Power Plant, and Mine) to generate massive amounts of mana, allowing for the casting of powerful threats like Karn Liberated, Wurmcoil Engine, and Ulamog, the Ceaseless Hunger. The deck also utilizes cards like Oblivion Stone and Ugin, the Spirit Dragon for board control, while using cards like Expedition Map and Sylvan Scrying to tutor for specific lands. The inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion adds an additional mana source for flexibility.

The deck focuses on aggressive tempo plays, utilizing cheap spells to quickly build a board presence and apply pressure on the opponent. The goal is to efficiently use burn spells and cheap creatures to deal damage quickly and close out the game before the opponent can stabilize. By combining cards that can provide card advantage, pump up creatures, and utilize graveyard recursion, the deck aims to maintain a fast and relentless pace to overwhelm the opponent and secure victory in the early game.

The deck focuses on assembling a toolkit of creatures that can be searched for and put into play quickly using spells like Chord of Calling and Eldritch Evolution. The main goal is to find and utilize combo pieces like Yawgmoth, Thran Physician and Grist, the Hunger Tide to gain incremental advantages, generate value, or win the game outright. The deck is resilient thanks to creatures like Strangleroot Geist and Young Wolf that can persist or come back from the graveyard, giving it the ability to adapt to different situations and outvalue opponents.

The main concept of this deck is to control the opponent's resources and board state using various removal spells and disrupt their mana base with cards like Blood Moon. It aims to overwhelm the opponent with big red creatures like Seasoned Pyromancer, Bonecrusher Giant, and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer. The deck also utilizes cards like Relic of Progenitus to disrupt graveyard strategies and has some burn spells like Lightning Bolt to close out the game. Overall, the focus is on controlling the game and deploying powerful threats to secure victory.

The deck focuses on quickly getting out cheap artifacts to take advantage of the affinity mechanic, reducing their cost. Cranial Plating and other equipment are used to pump up creatures for quick, aggressive attacks. Urza's Saga is a key card for this strategy, allowing for the quick tutor of important artifacts. Thoughtcast helps refill the hand with more threats and answers. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of early aggression and efficient card advantage.

This deck focuses on quick plays and aggressive creature attacks to overwhelm the opponent. It utilizes a mix of instant spells for disruption and removal, along with versatile creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Murktide Regent to deal damage swiftly. The deck aims to control the board with counterspells and removal while applying pressure with its creatures. It also includes card draw and selection to maintain a steady flow of threats and answers. Additionally, the mana base is optimized for consistency and access to all necessary colors.

The deck focuses on aggressive creatures that can be constantly blinked in and out of the battlefield to disrupt the opponent's strategy and gain advantage. It also includes cards that provide protection and evasion for key creatures, as well as disruption elements to slow down the opponent's game plan. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of aggressive creatures and disruptive tactics, ultimately leading to victory by outpacing the opponent's resources.

Control the game by utilizing artifacts and spells to generate creatures, disrupt opponent's strategies, and create value through card advantage. Use cards like Urza, Lord High Artificer and Thopter Foundry to generate tokens, while also using Stoneforge Mystic to search for key equipment like Sword of the Meek. Urza's Saga is a key land that can tutor for essential artifacts, while Metallic Rebuke and Portable Hole provide disruption against opposing threats. The deck aims to outvalue opponents by efficiently controlling the game and establishing a board presence that is difficult to overcome.

This deck focuses on utilizing cards like Indomitable Creativity, Transmogrify, and Archon of Cruelty to cheat powerful creatures into play quickly. The deck also includes cards like Wrenn and Six, Teferi, Time Raveler, and Spell Pierce to control the board and protect the combo pieces. The inclusion of Leyline Binding and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker adds consistency to the deck, while Prismari Command and Prismatic Ending provide versatile removal options. Overall, the deck aims to be creative in its combos and disrupt opponents with unexpected plays.

The main idea of this Modern Aggro - Red Deck Wins deck is to quickly deal damage to the opponent using efficient and versatile red cards. The deck includes a mix of burn spells, aggressive creatures, and disruption tools to create intense pressure on the opponent. The unique twist of having Obosh, the Preypiercer as a companion enhances the deck's ability to deal extra damage to the opponent with odd converted mana cost spells. Overall, the deck aims to win the game as fast as possible through relentless aggression and direct damage.

The deck focuses on utilizing artifacts and Urza, Lord High Artificer to control the game through token generation and disruption. By combining Thopter Foundry and Sword of the Meek to create a steady stream of flying creatures, along with Urza's ability to generate mana and card advantage, the deck aims to overwhelm opponents with a combination of aggression and control. The inclusion of cards like Goblin Engineer and Esper Sentinel provides additional utility and disruption, making it a versatile and resilient deck in the Modern format.

The key idea behind this deck is to use the UrzaTron lands (Urza's Mine, Power Plant, and Tower) to quickly ramp up mana and play high-costed threats like Wurmcoil Engine, Ulamog, and Karn Liberated. The deck also utilizes control elements like Oblivion Stone and Relic of Progenitus to disrupt the opponent's strategy while maintaining card advantage with cards like Ancient Stirrings and Sylvan Scrying. Jegantha, the Wellspring is included as a companion to provide additional mana fixing and a potential win condition. The overall strategy focuses on ramping into powerful threats while controlling the board.

The key strategy of this deck is to mill the opponent's library as quickly as possible using cards like Hedron Crab, Ruin Crab, and Fractured Sanity, while also disrupting their game plan with counterspells like Drown in the Loch and removal spells like Fatal Push. The deck also utilizes Archive Trap and Tasha's Hideous Laughter to punish opponents for searching their library. The goal is to quickly fill up the opponent's graveyard and win by milling them out, taking advantage of cards like Visions of Beyond to draw more cards and maintain card advantage.
